purpose: Complete-character walk keyframes; no puppet compositing

prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: complete hand-drawn 2D game character animation keyframe, WALK A, left-facing contact pose.
Reference image 1 supplies the exact character identity and detailed drawing style. Redraw the WHOLE character in a clean side view facing LEFT. Blue long wavy gradient hair, whale ears and whale tail, orange asterisk hair clip, cream hoodie with orange sleeve asterisk, caramel bow and tiny Claude badge, tan pleated skirt with white frill, white flower legwarmers, brown Mary Jane shoes. Keep all these features. Chibi anatomy and soft detailed cel shading faithful to reference, consistent thick outlines.
Pose: natural relaxed walk cycle contact key. NEAR leg (closest to camera) extends FORWARD toward LEFT, its heel just touching the floor, toe raised slightly. FAR leg extends BACK toward RIGHT, heel raised with toe touching the floor. Both legs clearly visible, anatomically attached under skirt. Near arm gently BACK toward right, far arm FORWARD left. Hips level, shoulders relaxed, head stable. Tail curves behind toward RIGHT.
One single complete character centered in a 1024x1536 portrait canvas. Full body including ahoge, tail and shoes, generous 70px clear margin, ground baseline y=1420, highest ahoge y=100. No background, genuinely transparent alpha. NO cast shadow, NO text labels, NO panel grid, NO pose lines, NO motion streaks. This is a drawn complete keyframe, no paper cutout joints.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: whole-character animation WALK B, single drawing. Image 1 is the edit target and master keyframe A. Keep the identical face, eyes, head silhouette, hairstyle, whale ear, ahoge, hoodie design, skirt, flower legwarmers, shoes, linework, shading, canvas, camera and scale. Facing LEFT. Preserve the upper body and head position precisely. Only redraw the walking pose into the next PASSING keyframe: NEAR leg that was forward in A is now supporting the body, vertically below the hip, shoe FLAT on baseline. FAR leg has lifted from behind and swings forward: knee BENT so foot is tucked behind the supporting calf toward RIGHT, shoe off ground by 100px. Two separate visible legs, no extra legs. Arms naturally close to vertical while swinging past torso; relaxed sleeves organically attached to shoulders. Hair and whale tail follow gently, almost same silhouette. Do not rotate the cut-out limbs; draw a coherent complete new figure. Transparent background with clean anti-aliased edges, no environment, no colored glow or shadow. Full character in same 1024x1536 canvas at same size and location. No text labels, no sheet, no grid. Exactly one whole character.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: complete character animation WALK C, opposite contact key.
Image 1 is the edit target, master key A; keep its EXACT head, expression, hair, ear, ahoge, clothing design, tail, camera, scale and location. One coherent full-body hand-drawn character facing LEFT. Do not mirror the image.
Redraw the walking pose one HALF CYCLE later: FAR leg (behind body, slightly darker) extends FORWARD toward LEFT, heel contacting the floor and toes tilted slightly up. NEAR leg (closest to viewer, brighter) extends BACK toward RIGHT, its heel raised and only toe touching the floor. Thus the nearer visible white flower legwarmer and Mary Jane on the RIGHT side of canvas is clearly in FRONT of the far leg in the overlap. Knees naturally flex; legs originate beneath skirt, not detached. Near arm swings FORWARD toward LEFT with a relaxed hand, far arm swings BACK toward RIGHT. Draw natural hoodie folds at shoulder and elbow; do not reuse reversed A leg layering. Hips and head remain stable, step length same as A, both ground-contact feet share baseline with A.
Preserve very consistent upper silhouette with A, no camera changes, no additional props, no labels or grid. A single whole character on genuinely transparent background, no shadows or glow, same 1024x1536 canvas.

Use case: identity-preserve. Image 1 is the character identity reference and master animation drawing. Image 2 is a schematic pose guide ONLY; do NOT draw the guide, labels or colors into artwork.
Create one COMPLETE character drawing, side view facing LEFT, same canvas, head and torso size and location as image 1. Keep the exact face, hair, ear, hoodie, bow, skirt, flower socks, brown Mary Jane shoes and whale tail.
Critical pose change: follow Image 2 leg depth and orientation. The NEAR leg is the one going BACKWARD to the RIGHT, and it must be drawn ON TOP / in front of the other leg at the upper-thigh overlap. Its knee and flower legwarmer are on the RIGHT, heel raised, shoe toe contacts floor. The FAR leg extends FORWARD LEFT, is partially hidden behind the near thigh, and slightly shaded; its shoe at LEFT contacts floor on the heel. The thigh that occupies the RIGHT half must cover the one occupying the LEFT half at the crotch. This is the opposite leg layering from Image 1, NOT the same leg pose.
Near sleeve swings very slightly forward LEFT but hand stays LOW next to skirt, a gentle relaxed walk, NOT a punch or forward reach. Far sleeve behind. All joints organically drawn, whole coherent illustration.
Use exact master head/torso/hairstyle, maintain scale and camera, keep all parts within canvas. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow, no labels, no guide marks. No extra limbs.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create COMPLETE character WALK D, the opposite passing pose, facing LEFT. Image 1 is the main edit target (opposite contact C), image 2 is previous passing B for pose comparison only. Keep image 1 character head, face, eye, ear, hair and tail, clothing identity and scale exactly.
Redraw all pose naturally in one coherent full-body illustration. This is the OPPOSITE passing position from image 2: the FAR leg supports the body vertically and its shoe sits FLAT below hip. The NEAR leg swings forward from behind: thigh slopes down-right, knee BENDS and foot lifts UP behind the standing calf to the RIGHT, visibly at least 100px above floor. The lifted near thigh and knee must visibly OVERLAP IN FRONT of the straight far thigh, unlike image 2 where the straight leg overlapped the lifted leg. Keep two legs only. The near foot is on right and above floor, its sock has the flower patch. Arms gently pass the sides in relaxed walk. Small natural cloth folds, no punch or hand reaching.
Same camera, full-body scale, 1024x1536 transparent canvas, top of ahoge and eye exactly match image 1, keep all extremities in frame. No floor, shadows, glow, writing, pose guide, or grid.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a SINGLE COMPLETE hand-drawn walking character keyframe on transparent canvas. Image 1 is the earlier pose, image 2 is the following pose. Preserve exact face/head/hair/whale ear/ahoge, hoodie with orange asterisk, tan skirt, socks, shoes, tail, style and camera scale. Full character facing LEFT, same 1024x1536 framing and head position, no labels, grid, guide or shadow. Coherent organically drawn body and cloth, two arms and two legs only. This is WALK E: DOWN / recoil phase between contact A and passing B. Near leg is planted forward LEFT, knee flexes slightly to absorb weight, shoe is now FLAT on ground. Far leg begins lifting from backward RIGHT: heel high, toe just leaves floor, knee bends. Near leg overlaps in FRONT of the far thigh. Stance width HALF that of image 1, not fully feet-together as image 2. Both legs readable. Arms halfway between their references, relaxed, no reaching. Hips lower 8px maximum, head remains stable.
